title: The Bell state is entangled while its local density is maximally mixed
statement: The canonical two-qubit Bell ket is entangled and its left marginal is I/2.
assumptions: Ket.MES Qubit is the normalized all-positive maximally entangled ket.
physical_scope: The Bell state (|00>+|11>)/sqrt(2); partial trace removes the right factor and yields the left qubit state.
target_source:
import QuantumInfo.States.Pure.Qubit

open scoped Matrix
open ComplexConjugate
open BigOperators

theorem physics_target  : (Ket.MES Qubit).IsEntangled ∧
    (MState.pure (Ket.MES Qubit)).traceRight.m =
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Qubit Qubit ℂ) := by
  sorry
